title: Search the reference library
description: Search read-only clones of reference repositories for a pattern (a regular expression). Use this when you are about to design something non-trivial that another project has already solved — an event stream, a scheduler, a plugin protocol, a retry policy. Results give `reference:<repo>/<path>` and a line number; read that path with read_file to see the surrounding code. These repositories are READ-ONLY: you cannot edit them, and nothing you read there is part of this project until you write it yourself.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression, e.g. "createServer|serve\\(" — case-insensitive by default.

repo.description: Limit to one reference repository by name. When this run was given a subject repository, that is the default — pass "*" to deliberately search every reference instead.

context.description: Lines of surrounding context to include per hit (default 0).

maxPerFile.description: Cap on hits from any one file (default 3), so a noisy file cannot hide the one that answers the question.

examples: search the references for how a session event stream is fanned out to clients
find prior art for pinning a supervisor to a known-good revision
